I plant maize with groundnut on this plot every year, just as my father taught me. Last season I put one bag of NPK here through my FISP coupon and the cobs were good, so I will do the same this year, plus two buckets of goat manure because I own this land and want it to stay fertile. I will use hybrid seed I saved from last year’s FISP pack, and I will not buy chemicals or irrigate — we depend on the November rains and weed by hand. My wife and I will do all the work in about 22 days; I will not hire ganyu labor because the plot is small and I must keep my cash for other needs.
